description: Agent Treasury: submit open invoices (counterparty, amount, currency, issue date, due date) with the current date. The signed brief totals them by bucket (current, 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and over 90 days overdue), lists the overdue invoices oldest first and states the total at risk. Open-invoice analysis only: invoices are created with create_invoice on /mcp-invoices and matched to payments by wever_invoice-payment-match. Verdict all_current, overdue or overdue_over_90. POST /api/invoice-aging-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no wallet, chain, market, bank or counterparty lookup, and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-treasury-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-treasury/.
